BUILDPLAN.md T-11 (M2).

Lifecycle: 4 h expiry, room deleted at release, totals with expiry, **`used` written at release**, take-it-home rebuild at release, *Run it again* refuses a used question

Criteria: AC-56, AC-57, AC-69, AC-92, G-4, G-10
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-04b
BUILDPLAN notes: **The only writer of the used-question ledger.**

Orchestrator notes: The only writer of the used-question ledger (G-10). Touches `room/src/phase.rs` (F-10): serialized.

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

ORCHESTRATOR add-on (from PQ-35's findings; room/README.md is cleared to you this wave): (1) the *Running it* stand-in command 'cd room && HOST_DEV_TOKEN=<any value> cargo run --features dev-host-token' fails because the crate has four binaries — make it 'cargo run --bin room --features dev-host-token' (run it to prove it); (2) the sentence saying the host phone shows the wall's address is out of date since PR #27 — rewrite it to what the host screen shows now (read web/host on main). Land both in your README commit; list under deviations.

PLAN-NOTE PQ-14 contract gaps for the Orchestrator (sides taken, no contract files edited): (T4) SPEC §13 take-it-home needs why_tempting for EVERY incorrect option and the verified record's detail rows (-Vv, target, flags, Miri configs); answers.rs's witnessed read (Revealed) lends neither — only the room's middle why_tempting via Verdict. I am not reaching into the sealed module; the snapshot carries what Revealed gives and omits those fields. T-12 needs an additive witnessed read in answers.rs — please assign. (T5) bank.py Fit is Literal[fits|clipped_x|clipped_y|clipped_xy] with no null, but a room can release with no wall verdict ever reported; I write fit: null rather than invent one. Pipeline type may need Optional. (T6) mvp/tools/build_deck.py:233 still writes mvp/answer-history.json at build time; mvp/** is contract-protected so I leave it; the room crate writes nothing at build and a test asserts it. (T1-T3) boot-prompt asks for counts in the snapshot and totals surviving release; AC-56/AC-95/D-12/§4.6 say none — the criteria win: no counts survive release. Released room is hollowed (no sessions/totals/verdict/counts) but its phase shell lives to 4 h so the released views and Run it again still work; deleted whole at expiry.

ORCHESTRATOR rulings on your PLAN-NOTE. (T1-T3) Criteria win, with AC-56 read literally: 'No per-person answer record outlives the room. Only anonymous totals persist, and they expire with it.' So: per-person records gone at release (as you have it); the anonymous per-option totals stay on the hollowed room shell until its 4 h expiry, then go with it — do not hollow the totals at release, hollow the sessions. The take-it-home snapshot carries exactly the fields SPEC §13 displays and nothing more; where §13 names a count (AC-95's count from release, the most-chosen incorrect option), carry that count; where it names none, carry none. Your phase-shell-to-expiry design for released views and Run it again is accepted. (T4) Accepted: the snapshot carries what the witnessed Revealed read gives today; the additive witnessed read in answers.rs (every incorrect option's why_tempting and the verified detail rows, after reveal only) is assigned to T-12 / PQ-15 — name the seam in room/README.md and in your DONE. (T5) Write fit: null when the wall never reported a verdict; the pipeline's Fit becomes Optional on PQ-25's side (noted there); routed upstream as F-30 (SPEC §3.3 fit may be absent). (T6) Correct to leave mvp/**: build_deck.py's ledger write is the MVP deck's, outside this crate; your build-writes-nothing test covers the room. Recorded for the client as the retire-when-the-deck-retires item. Proceed.

DONE PQ-14 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/30 HEAD c61bd1547e398edcc77422c33890397575fc73b0 BASE 934e6c8f7864e008d509dd2dcd865b7a0b836f9c test-warm 12.4 deviations: (1) released room keeps its phase shell (id, code, organizer, host session, phase) plus the anonymous totals/answered/verdict until its 4 h expiry instead of deletion at release — sessions and live counts drop at release; per your ruling on AC-56 (SPEC §4.6 / EVALUATION AC-56 text still says deleted at release: upstream wording to amend). (2) take-it-home snapshot and used record carry no count (§13 names none). (3) snapshot lacks every incorrect option's why_tempting and the verified detail rows — the witnessed read is PQ-15's; seam named in room/README.md. (4) used.fit is null when the wall never reported a verdict (F-30, PQ-25). (5) README add-on landed: stand-in command is 'cargo run --bin room --features dev-host-token' (run and proven: GET /host 200, create 201) and the host-screen sentence rewritten to what #27 shows (code, not the wall's address). (6) Snapshot exposed by typed accessor AppState::take_home(), no /last.json route — nothing serves it before T-12. (7) meetup_date = created_at's date in America/New_York, a constant used::MEETUP_ZONE (config.rs not cleared to me). notes: phase.rs untouched — release its serialization. mvp/tools/build_deck.py:233 still writes answer-history.json at build (out of scope per your T6 ruling). AppState::leave's grace for gone sockets is not built (not in T-11's deliverables). Reviews: PASS-WITH-NITS then PASS (attached). just canary green; just test-web 192/192; CI checks were in progress at open.

Your branch is pushed, so never rebase: after your PR is open, if GitHub reports it not mergeable, git merge origin/main as a plain merge commit and push. Otherwise nothing to do.
